messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

content: {"sentences": ["i think the loop goes through all the numbers and puts them in order in one pass.", "maybe each swap fixes the bigger number so the array becomes sorted after one pass.", "not sure but the if condition checks pairs and swaps so smallest comes first eventually.", "i think j goes from 0 to 2 so it checks every pair and orders them completely.", "maybe the swapping moves 1 all the way to the front, making it sorted like 1,2,3,4."]}

sentences: i think the loop goes through all the numbers and puts them in order in one pass.
maybe each swap fixes the bigger number so the array becomes sorted after one pass.
not sure but the if condition checks pairs and swaps so smallest comes first eventually.
i think j goes from 0 to 2 so it checks every pair and orders them completely.
maybe the swapping moves 1 all the way to the front, making it sorted like 1,2,3,4.
